answer: Each identity must burn one relic token. The registry keeps an ivory ledger of serials, one per identity, and refuses reuse. A burned relic cannot be re-minted, so the k-th fake identity must buy a relic: the first costs 55 credits, the k-th costs 55+5(k-1), and 1,000 fakes burn 2,552,500 credits. An ember audit each epoch samples identities and demands the burn receipt and provenance chain; a rented relic fails because its serial sits in the ivory ledger or its chain breaks, and the renter's bond is burned. An honest agent burns one 55-credit relic and posts one bond.
